ev.k4_hand_me_down.title: New to you
ev.k4_hand_me_down.text: Your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} {npc} has outgrown {g=npc_sex:his|her} clothes, and now they are yours: sleeves rolled up twice, someone else's patch on the elbow, and they still smell of {g=npc_sex:him|her}. In them you look like a sack with legs.
ev.k4_hand_me_down.beg_new: Beg the grown-ups for something new, all your own
ev.k4_hand_me_down.beg_new.success: The grown-ups looked at each other and sighed, but by the festival you had new clothes. Yours, nobody else's! You slept with them under your head.
ev.k4_hand_me_down.beg_new.failure: 'New? Wear those till they fall apart,' came the answer. And after you, someone else will wear them too.
ev.k4_hand_me_down.mark: Stitch your own sign on the hem to make them yours
ev.k4_protect_little.title: Leave the little one alone
ev.k4_protect_little.text: Some bigger boys from down the street have cornered your little {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} and taken {g=npc_sex:his|her} toy. {npc} is howling and looking around for you.
ev.k4_protect_little.fight: Go at them with your fists
ev.k4_protect_little.fight.success: You flew at them so fiercely that the big boys backed off and dropped the toy. All evening {npc} followed you around like a shadow.
ev.k4_protect_little.fight.failure: They knocked you down and gave you a black eye. But you never let go of the toy, and {npc} looked at you like a hero.
ev.k4_protect_little.grab_run: Grab the little one's hand and run home
ev.k4_protect_little.shame: Shame them loud enough for the whole street to hear
ev.k4_protect_little.shame.success: 'Three of you against a baby? What heroes!' you shouted, so loudly that the neighbor women looked out of their yards. The boys shoved the toy back and ran.
ev.k4_protect_little.shame.failure: The boys just laughed and mimicked you in a squeaky voice. You had to trade one of your own toys to get it back.
ev.k4_protect_later.title: My turn now
ev.k4_protect_later.text: A quarrel at the well is about to become a fight: three men are coming at you. Then {npc} steps between you - no little one any more. 'Remember how you fought for me when I was this small? My turn now.'
ev.k4_protect_later.together.success: The two of you looked so grim that there was no fight. The three shuffled off, and you laughed for ages, remembering that stolen toy.
ev.k4_protect_later.together.failure: There was a fight after all, and you both took a beating. But you walked home arm in arm, wiping your bloody noses.
ev.k4_shared_punishment.title: One pile of beans for two
ev.k4_shared_punishment.text: You and your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} argued so loudly over who got to sit nearer the fire that Father set you both to sort a mountain of beans until dark. Together, on one mat, and not a word. {npc} sits there sulking, flinging beans as if they were to blame.
ev.k4_shared_punishment.joke.success: You laid out a funny face in beans that looked just like Father. {npc} snorted, then burst out laughing, and by the end of the punishment you were allies again.
ev.k4_shared_punishment.joke.failure: Father heard the giggling and silently poured out a second pile. At least you laughed at that one together.
ev.k4_sick_attention.title: As if you weren't there
ev.k4_sick_attention.text: {npc} has been ill for days, and Mother never leaves {g=npc_sex:his|her} bedside. It's as if you've vanished: nobody asks whether you've eaten, nobody notices the new scrape on your knee.
ev.k4_sick_attention.help: Help Mother: fetch water, sit by the bed
ev.k4_sick_attention.act_out: Throw a tantrum so someone finally notices you
ev.k4_sick_attention.act_out.success: Mother suddenly turned from the bed, hugged you and wouldn't let go. 'You think I don't see? I see everything,' she whispered.
ev.k4_sick_attention.act_out.failure: 'Of all the times!' Mother snapped. You cried in the corner for a long while, and nobody came.
ev.k4_sick_attention.alone: Slip away and play by yourself
ev.k4_show_off.title: Boasting before guests
ev.k4_show_off.text: There are guests, and {npc}, your father, mellow from the feast, is boasting to the whole house: 'Mine can count to a hundred and knows every song!' Everyone turns to you. So far you can count to forty.
ev.k4_show_off.perform: Step into the middle and show them
ev.k4_show_off.perform.success: You counted to forty and then burst into song so briskly that everyone forgot about the counting. Father beamed all evening, as if he'd sung it himself.
ev.k4_show_off.perform.failure: At twenty-seven you lost count, at thirty you burst into tears. The guests consoled you with sweets, and Father coughed into his fist.
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.title: Voices through the wall
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.text: At night you wake to voices. Father and Mother are quarreling - quietly and bitterly, about what there's never enough of, and about somebody's relatives. You lie still, afraid to breathe.
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.cover: Cover your ears and pretend to sleep
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.go_out: Get up and go to them
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.go_out.success: They stopped mid-word. Mother scooped you up, Father awkwardly stroked your head, and the house was quiet until morning.
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.go_out.failure: 'Back to bed!' they barked at once. At least they agree on that.
ev.k4_parents_quarrel.reconcile: In the morning, secretly leave each of them something nice
ev.k4_father_away.title: In charge
ev.k4_father_away.text: {npc}, your father, is going off to work far away - a whole season, maybe longer. At the door he crouches down in front of you: 'So, who's in charge here while I'm gone?'
ev.k4_father_away.promise: 'Me!' - and promise to look after the house
ev.k4_father_away.gift: Ask him to bring you a present
ev.k4_father_away.cling: Hang on to him and not let go
ev.k4_father_back.title: A stranger at the door
ev.k4_father_back.text: {npc}, your father, is back - thin, weathered, a bundle on his shoulder. At first you don't even recognize him. And he looks at you and doesn't recognize you either: you've grown so much. In the bundle is everything he earned.
ev.k4_father_back.hug: Throw your arms around his neck
ev.k4_father_back.shy: Hide: this man seems like a stranger
ev.k4_father_back.report: Report how you looked after the house
ev.k4_mother_secret.title: The bundle under the mat
ev.k4_mother_secret.text: You see {npc}, your mother, hiding a bundle in a hollow in the corner, under the mat: her earrings and something heavy that clinks. She turns and meets your eyes. 'Not a word to your father,' she whispers. 'This is for a rainy day.'
ev.k4_mother_secret.ask: Ask what trouble she's saving it for
ev.k4_mother_secret.ask.success: Mother was silent a long time, then told you about the hungry year of her childhood, when her family had nothing left, not even pots. 'May you never see that.'
ev.k4_mother_secret.ask.failure: 'You're too young to ask such things,' Mother snapped, and didn't look at you until evening.
ev.k4_hidden_savings.title: That rainy day
ev.k4_hidden_savings.text: It's a lean year, and every handful counts. Then {npc}, your mother, silently takes that same bundle from under the mat. 'You didn't give me away back then. So you decide what it goes on.'
ev.k4_hidden_savings.food: Buy food for the whole family
ev.k4_hidden_savings.invest: Save it for something that will lift the household
ev.k4_burnt_dish.title: Something's burning
ev.k4_burnt_dish.text: {npc}, your mother, has trusted you with the family dish for the first time - the one made her own mother's way. You looked away for just a moment, and now the smell of burning is creeping through the house. Soon everyone will sit down to eat.
ev.k4_burnt_dish.confess.success: The second time it came out almost like hers. Mother tasted it, paused, and said: 'There. Now you know where it catches.'
ev.k4_burnt_dish.confess.failure: The second batch burned too. Everyone ate it anyway - and even praised it, glancing at you with pity.
ev.k4_burnt_dish.scrape: Take the unburnt part off the top and serve it as if nothing happened
ev.k4_burnt_dish.scrape.success: Nobody noticed a thing. Only old Grandfather said it tasted special today, a bit smoky, and asked for more.
ev.k4_burnt_dish.scrape.failure: One bite and everyone knew. They laughed at you all evening and talked about 'the smoky dish' for years.
ev.k4_lost_ring.title: Great-grandfather's ring
ev.k4_lost_ring.text: You secretly took great-grandfather's old ring - the one the family has kept longer than anyone can remember - to show your friends. And now it's gone: not in your sash, not in the dust, nowhere. Father will notice any moment.
ev.k4_lost_ring.search: Search on your knees until dark
ev.k4_lost_ring.search.success: You crawled over the same ground until something glinted in a crack by a stone. You pressed the ring to your chest and swore never to touch it again.
ev.k4_lost_ring.search.failure: You searched until dark and came home with nothing. You had to tell, and Father gave you a look worse than any blow.
ev.k4_lost_ring.silent: Say nothing and hope nobody notices
ev.k4_ring_found.title: A find by the old wall
ev.k4_ring_found.text: A neighbor digging by the old wall brings over his find: a ring gone green with age. You know it at once. Great-grandfather's ring, the one the family has spoken of all these years: 'Vanished, as if the earth swallowed it.'
ev.k4_ring_found.confess: Take it and finally confess to the family
ev.k4_ring_found.quiet: Thank the neighbor and quietly put the ring back in its place
ev.k4_ring_found.let_go: Say nothing: let the finder keep it
ev.k4_moving.title: The last minute
ev.k4_moving.text: The grown-ups have decided: there's no living here any more, the family is moving to another region. The bundles are tied, the hearth is out, the neighbors have come out to see you off. You have one last minute.
ev.k4_moving.earth: Take a handful of earth from the doorstep
ev.k4_moving.goodbye: Run round everyone you played with and say goodbye
ev.k4_moving.hide: Hide: maybe they'll go without you
ev.k4_moving.hide.success: They searched for you till evening, and the departure was put off till morning. One more night under the old roof - and nobody even scolded you: they were too tired.
ev.k4_moving.hide.failure: They found you almost at once, by your sticking-out heels. You began the journey with sore ears.
ev.k4_lean_year.title: Everything you can live without
ev.k4_lean_year.text: It's a lean year. The grown-ups are selling everything you can live without: festival clothes, the best pot, necklaces. You have a treasure of your own - {g:a carved spinning top|a string of colored stone beads} - and you know it could be sold too.
ev.k4_lean_year.give: Take your treasure to the grown-ups yourself
ev.k4_lean_year.hide: Bury it under a tree where no one will find it
ev.k4_lean_year.earn: Go to the neighbors: maybe they need help for a handful of food
ev.k4_lean_year.earn.success: You carried water for the neighbors until dark and came home with a little bundle of grain. The grown-ups untied it as carefully as if it held gold.
ev.k4_lean_year.earn.failure: The neighbors have nothing to eat themselves. They patted your head and sent you home.
ev.k4_sudden_luck.title: Unexpected fortune
ev.k4_sudden_luck.text: Luck came to the house when no one expected it: a distant relative everyone had long forgotten left you all his goods. The grown-ups are cheerful, and at the market, for the first time, you're allowed to choose a present yourself.
ev.k4_sudden_luck.self: Choose the thing you've dreamed of for ages
ev.k4_sudden_luck.share: Buy sweets for all the family and the neighbors' children
ev.k4_sudden_luck.save: Refuse: better to put it aside
ev.k4_guest.title: The guest's riddle
ev.k4_guest.text: An important guest is staying the night - a gray-haired man who has seen half the world. You've been told to bring water and keep quiet. But suddenly the guest turns to you: 'Now then, little one: what is lighter than a feather, yet even a strong man can't hold it?'
ev.k4_guest.answer.success: 'Your breath!' you blurted. The guest roared with laughter, slapped his knee and asked your name. 'I'll remember,' he said seriously.
ev.k4_guest.answer.failure: 'A stone!' you blurted, and everyone laughed. The guest ruffled your hair kindly: 'Never mind, you'll grow.'
ev.k4_guest.silent: Bow silently and bring the water
ev.k4_guest.ask: Ask him back whether he's really seen the edge of the world
ev.k4_guest_patron.title: A messenger from an old guest
ev.k4_guest_patron.text: A messenger comes to the gate: 'My master once spent a night in your house. He remembers the {g:boy|girl} who guessed his riddle about breath. He is old now, and he needs clever people around him.'
ev.k4_old_kin_dying.title: She asked for you
ev.k4_old_kin_dying.text: The old relative who was living out her days in a corner of your house has taken to her bed and won't get up again. The grown-ups speak in whispers. Today she asked for you - you, of all people.
ev.k4_old_kin_dying.sit: Sit beside her and take her hand
ev.k4_old_kin_dying.sit.ok: She stroked your palm for a long time and called you by someone else's name - the name of someone she loved long, long ago. Three days later she was gone, but your palm remembered the warmth for a long time.
ev.k4_old_kin_dying.bring.ok: She couldn't eat a bite, but she held the fruit in her hand and smiled. 'Sweet,' she said, though she never tasted it.
ev.k4_old_kin_dying.afraid.ok: You sat behind the house until they called you to eat. A few days later she was gone, and for a long time you couldn't forgive yourself.
ev.k4_genealogy.title: Seven generations
ev.k4_genealogy.text: The oldest of the clan, a great-uncle, has decided it's time: you must know the names of your ancestors - seven generations, one after another, without a stumble. He chants them like a song and watches you sternly.
ev.k4_genealogy.text.east_asian: The oldest of the clan, a great-uncle, has led you to the ancestral tablets: you must know the name of everyone written there - seven generations, one after another, without a stumble. He chants them and watches you sternly.
ev.k4_genealogy.text.african: The oldest of the clan, a great-uncle, has decided it's time: you must know your ancestors - seven generations, one after another, with their praise names and deeds, the way the singers of the past recite them. He chants them and watches you sternly.
ev.k4_genealogy.learn: Drill them until you know them
ev.k4_genealogy.learn.success: At the family feast you chanted all seven generations without a single slip. The old folk wiped their eyes, and great-uncle looked round at everyone proudly, as if he'd done it himself.
ev.k4_genealogy.learn.failure: At the third generation you slipped the neighbors' dog's name into the list. Everyone roared with laughter except great-uncle.
ev.k4_genealogy.story: Ask what just one of them was like
ev.k4_genealogy.joke: Invent one more ancestor, for a laugh
ev.k4_lineage_later.title: Whose well
ev.k4_lineage_later.text: A dispute has broken out with the neighboring clan over the old well: whoever's great-grandfather dug it has the right to it. The old people who remembered are gone. Everyone looks at you: as a child you learned all seven generations.
ev.k4_lineage_later.recite: Chant the lineage in front of everyone
ev.k4_lineage_later.recite.success: You began to chant the way great-uncle taught you, and at the fifth generation you named the very man who dug it. The neighbors looked at each other and fell silent. The dispute was settled.
ev.k4_lineage_later.recite.failure: At the fourth generation you stumbled, and the neighbors laughed you down at once. The dispute dragged on for a long time.
ev.k4_lineage_later.concede: Give way: there's water enough for all
ev.k4_night_fire.title: Keeping the fire
ev.k4_night_fire.text: For the first time you've been trusted to keep the hearth fire through the night: feed it a little at a time, so there's something to blow back to life in the morning. Everyone is asleep. Your eyes keep closing on their own.
ev.k4_night_fire.awake.success: You pinched your arm, counted the stars through a gap in the roof and held out till dawn. In the morning you got the first bite, like a grown-up.
ev.k4_night_fire.awake.failure: You woke up cold: the hearth was gray ash. You had to run to the neighbors for embers in a pot, and the whole street knew why.
ev.k4_night_fire.bank: Bury the embers in ash, the way the grown-ups do, and lie down
ev.k4_night_fire.bank.success: Under the ash the embers glowed till morning. You slept well and had the fire going before anyone else. Clever - and honest, too.
ev.k4_night_fire.bank.failure: You buried the embers too deep, and they smothered. The morning began with borrowed embers and a lot of grumbling.
ev.k4_baby_minding.title: Nursemaid
ev.k4_baby_minding.text: The grown-ups are at work from dawn to dusk, and you've been left with your baby {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} {npc}. And out in the street they're calling you: a game is starting, and they won't begin without you.
ev.k4_baby_minding.take_along.success: You played with one hand holding on to the baby. {npc} laughed louder than anyone and was promptly declared the game's lucky charm.
ev.k4_baby_minding.take_along.failure: You got carried away for just a minute, and {npc} was already sitting in a puddle chewing something {g=npc_sex:he|she} had found. The washing took a long time, and the explaining even longer.
ev.k4_baby_minding.stay: Stay and sing to the baby
ev.k4_baby_minding.invite: Get everyone to come and play in your yard
ev.k4_family_meal.title: The best piece
ev.k4_family_meal.text: The whole family has gathered round the shared dish. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece first, before your elders. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.christian: The whole family has gathered at the table. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the elders have said grace and crossed themselves. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.islamic: The whole family has gathered round the shared dish. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the eldest has said 'bismillah'. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.jewish: The whole family has gathered at the table. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the eldest has said the blessing over the bread. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.dharmic: The whole family has sat down to eat. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the first handful has been set aside for the gods. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.east_asian: The whole family has sat down to eat. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the elders have even picked up their chopsticks. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.polytheist: The whole family has gathered round the shared dish. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the share for the household gods has been set aside. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.mesoamerican: The whole family has gathered by the hearth. You're so hungry that you reach for the best tortilla before the first morsel has been tossed into the fire for the gods. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.andean: The whole family has gathered by the hearth. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the eldest has given the first pinch to Pachamama, Mother Earth. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.text.african: The whole family has gathered round the shared dish. You're so hungry that you reach for the best piece before the eldest has dropped the first pinch on the ground for the ancestors. Your hand freezes in midair: everyone is looking at you.
ev.k4_family_meal.put_back: Put it back and say sorry
ev.k4_family_meal.eat_fast: Pop it in your mouth, quick
ev.k4_family_meal.eat_fast.success: You swallowed it before anyone could gasp. The elders were so taken aback that they burst out laughing, and the family talked about that supper for a long time.
ev.k4_family_meal.eat_fast.failure: It stuck in your throat, you started coughing, and while they thumped you on the back, supper ended for you.
ev.k4_family_meal.offer: Hold the piece out to the eldest
ev.k4_rivalry.title: Who gets more
ev.k4_rivalry.text: Father has promised: whoever gathers more firewood by noon will go to town with him. {npc} has already run on ahead, and {g=npc_sex:his|her} arms are longer and legs faster.
ev.k4_rivalry.fair.success: You dragged home an armful taller than your own head. Father eyed the two piles, grunted and took you to town.
ev.k4_rivalry.fair.failure: {npc} was faster. You stood at the gate and watched them walk off without you.
ev.k4_rivalry.cheat: Secretly move some of {g=npc_sex:his|her} pile onto yours
ev.k4_rivalry.cheat.success: The trick worked: you were the one taken to town. Only something gnawed at you the whole way.
ev.k4_rivalry.cheat.failure: You were caught with an armful of someone else's firewood. Nobody went to town, and {npc} didn't speak to you for a week.
ev.k4_rivalry.give_up: Gather together and give it all to {g=npc_sex:him|her}
ev.k4_rivalry_later.title: An old debt
ev.k4_rivalry_later.text: {npc} has come to ask for a loan, and not a small one. Seeing you hesitate, {g=npc_sex:he|she} smirks: 'Remember the firewood? I saw everything back then. Call it a debt you've owed me since we were children.'
ev.k4_rivalry_later.help_hands: Laugh, own up and offer to help with work instead
ev.k4_m_doorpost.text: {npc}, your father, stood you with your back against the post by the door and cut a notch above your head. The new notch was two fingers higher than the last, and all day you walked on tiptoe to be taller still.
ev.k4_m_combing.text: {npc}, your mother, combed through your hair with a fine comb and told you, in passing, how at your age she climbed a tree after someone else's fruit and was too scared to come down until evening.
ev.k4_m_secret_words.text: Your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} {npc} and you made up a secret language: 'burum' means 'grown-ups coming', 'shishmish' means 'something tasty'. The grown-ups get cross, and you two giggle.
ev.k4_m_one_bed.text: You all sleep together in one bed, and your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} {npc} kicks in {g=npc_sex:his|her} sleep and steals the whole blanket. But with two of you it isn't scary when something rustles outside.
ev.k4_m_father_song.text: {npc}, your father, always sings the same song while he works - and always off-key. You know it by heart, mistakes and all.
ev.k4_m_guests_first.text: When guests come, the children eat last. You sat in the corner watching the best pieces disappear - and so you learned the first rule of hospitality.
ev.k4_m_years_by_troubles.text: The old man next door counts years not in numbers but in troubles: 'That was two summers after the plague, the year the water went away.' You tried counting your own years that way and got two troubles and one wedding.
ev.k4_m_parents_laugh.text: Late in the evening you heard Father and Mother laughing quietly about something of their own. You didn't understand a word, but you fell asleep more peacefully than you had in a long time.
ev.k4_m_mother_asleep.text: {npc}, your mother, fell asleep sitting up, work still in her hands, before she finished your song. You covered her with your blanket and sat beside her for a long time, very, very quietly.
ev.k4_m_father_bandage.text: You split your knee open on a stone. {npc}, your father, washed the cut and bound it with his huge rough hands - as carefully as if he were mending a bird's wing.
ev.k4_m_cousins.text: The cousins descended - a whole crowd of them. The house got so crowded that the children were put to sleep in the yard under the open sky, and it was the best night of the year.
ev.k4_m_your_name.text: At last they told you where your name comes from: it belonged to a man who once saved the whole family. All day you strutted about as if you had saved them yourself.
ev.k4_m_piggyback.text: Your big {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} {npc} carries you piggyback when you get tired on the road, grumbling that you're heavier than a sack of grain. But {g=npc_sex:he|she} has never once put you down.
ev.k4_m_father_silence.text: For your mischief {npc}, your father, didn't shout: he simply didn't speak to you for a whole day. A whipping would have been better - it wouldn't have felt so awful.
ev.k4_m_mother_name.text: Suddenly you heard a neighbor call your mother by name: '{npc}!' So Mother has a name of her own, and once she was a little girl too. This needed thinking about.
ev.k4_m_rich_aunt.text: A rich relative dropped by, her bracelets jingling. The grown-ups suddenly turned strangely polite, and you were washed twice - all for one pinch on the cheek.
ev.k4_m_riddles.text: In the evening everyone sat by the fire with small work in their hands, asking riddles. You guessed one, the easiest, and the pride warmed you more than the fire.
ev.k4_m_sticky_raid.text: Your {g=npc_sex:brother|sister} {npc} and you sneaked into the storeroom for dried fruit. The evidence was on both your cheeks, but you swore to the end it wasn't you.
ev.k4_m_slave_mother.text: {npc}, your mother, works in the master's house from dawn till night. You see her only late in the evening, when she comes in smelling of someone else's kitchen and silently holds you close.
ev.k4_m_noble_father.text: {npc}, your father, is someone you see on feast days: servants and nurses raise you. Today he suddenly spoke to you and asked what you're being taught. You were so flustered you answered in a whisper.
